title: Team Member Card
description: The consultant card from the live team archive and the homepage “Meet our safari gurus” row. Unlike the archive cards it does not scrim the whole photograph — a 70px band sits along the bottom at neutral-900 70%, carrying the name in uppercase base type, and the bio panel slides up over the image on hover. Measured from `.post-type-archive-lsx-to-team … .lsx-to-archive-content`, which sets rgba(26, 18, 5, 0.7) on a 70px absolute strip. The reveal animation, its keyboard-focus equivalent, the editor override that keeps the panel open so it can be edited, and the reduced-motion fallback all live in assets/styles/core-group.css, because the block-style compiler strips :hover and :focus-within from this file.

styles.css: & { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } & > * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; margin-block-end: 0 !important; } & .team-member-card__media { margin: 0 !important; } & .team-member-card__media figure { margin: 0 !important; line-height: 0; } & .team-member-card__name { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; margin: 0 !important; min-height: 70px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--20); background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-900) 70%, transparent); } & .team-member-card__overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0 !important; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--40); background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-900) 80%, transparent); }
